Interface ServerNotifier

All Known Subinterfaces:
ServerNetworkAdapter
All Known Implementing Classes:
HybridServerNetworkAdapter, RMIClientConnection, RMIServerNetworkAdapter, SocketServerNetworkAdapter
public interface ServerNotifier
Sends server-to-client notifications for lobby, match, and shutdown events.
